title: The Quiet Launch
goal: Co-create three positively stated school expectations and examples for hallways, classrooms and shared spaces.

title: Evidence Hunters
goal: Find two credible sources for a class claim, identify limitations, and explain why one source is stronger.

title: Kindness Relay
goal: Complete three specific, observable acts that make another student's learning easier; reflection is required for credit.

title: Design the Future Classroom
goal: Propose one change to the learning environment, predict benefits/risks, and present a low-cost pilot.

title: Mastery Boss: Explain It Three Ways
goal: Demonstrate mastery of one concept using words, a diagram, and a worked example.

title: Repair Quest
goal: After a conflict, identify impact, choose a safe repair action, and document what support would reduce recurrence. Participation must never replace required safeguarding procedures.

title: Community Cartographers
goal: Map five helpful resources in the school/community and explain who can access each resource.

title: Build a Better Rule
goal: Evaluate one classroom routine using clarity, fairness, feasibility and accessibility; propose a revision.
